message: Windows and Android retain their published updates. Linux and macOS automatic updates start from the fresh full 1.0.2 release, distributed separately by the maintainer.
notes:
1. Added support for large updates delivered in verified parts. Small updates remain one file, and all required parts are checked before installation. Existing clients receive a compatible update before using the new format.
2. Preparing several Windows patches now runs in the background and can be cancelled. The updater verifies the target version before installation and checks it again before reporting success.
3. Fixed animated card art being skipped on ordinary card frames. Video availability and playback now use the same configured artwork paths.
4. Deck counts now update immediately after deleting or moving decks, and deleted entries no longer return in search results.
5. Fixed controller Cancel opening Settings during tribute selection or hiding a summon-without-tribute prompt instead of choosing No. Duel commands now show native focus corners, field Cancel shows its device glyph, and selection card previews show the detail shortcut.
6. Restored native Synchro rings, stars and level indicators for Chaos Angel, Kewl Tune and saved replay playback when the material levels are known.
7. Fixed completed match games opening another surrender prompt when the server's side-deck or match-end message arrives after result confirmation.
8. Restored the cursor and selection highlight in every Puzzle Creator text box, widened the cursor, and fixed Advanced Lua scrolling to follow it.
9. Fixed repeated Graveyard and banishment taps shifting the mobile duel interface and exposing a blank card-details template.
10. Clicking to advance duel actions now lets the full voice line continue. Leaving the duel still stops its remaining speech.
11. Rush cards now show the current-turn Normal Summon status without a duplicate generic label. The historical status returns when the turn-specific hint expires.
12. Fixed stretched Pendulum artwork while preserving full-height Master Duel art and fitting wide or square custom art. Corrected the placement of animated Pendulum artwork inside its frame.
13. Fixed a cancelled drag-and-drop effect choice leaving its zone selected for the next card, which could bypass Manual card placement.
14. Reduced the delay when opening the large card preview for the first time in Deck Editor.
15. Restored controller input on the boot title and added a prompt for the current controller's configured confirm button.
16. Deck Editor now prepares shared controls during startup and reuses them across local decks, reducing repeated loading and card-button creation.
17. Reduced card-loading stalls when returning from Character Voice or Appearance by reusing static card thumbnails. New thumbnails load with bounded parallel requests while animated cards keep their normal playback lifetime.
18. Common menu button sounds now load before the menu becomes ready, fixing silent interactions just after startup.
19. Restored sounds for Card appearance tabs, finish/frame/name choices, paging and cancellation with mouse or controller input.
20. Audited the local and release-source videos and corrected missing color metadata and reordered playback timestamps in affected animated card artworks.
21. Fixed deck names disappearing after hidden preparation and cleared interrupted card drags when leaving Deck Editor.
22. Updates and installers now preserve personal card rarities, decorations and bookmarks. Release tools exclude these files from both payloads and deletion lists.
23. Card choices now save atomically with a previous-generation backup. Unreadable data is preserved instead of being overwritten with empty defaults.
24. Link Evolution campaigns now let you choose a saved deck independently for yourself and your opponent, or restore the original story decks.
25. Added a Battle City Tournament Creator with character and deck assignments, 4/8/16 entrants, best-of series, optional third-place matches, saved progress and an animated bracket. Play your games against Dovphin and explicitly simulate other CPU matches.
26. Automatic card descriptions now respect Off when response dialogs and card-selection lists open; manual card inspection remains available.
27. Restored SEVENS and GO RUSH card-specific summon, effect, Spell/Trap and attack dialogue, including alternate artworks.
28. Tournament Creator now supports real players over LAN or Evolution: invite opponents with their own decks, record your games automatically and confirm other pairings as organizer. The bracket stays saved on the organizer's device.
29. Tournament pairing windows now show larger character portraits, a central score and series markers, with clearer actions and a dimmed backdrop.
30. Added optional native Duel Links 3D fields under Duel Appearance, with rendered thumbnails, animated previews, original scenery, aligned card outlines and upright decks. A separate option supplies the extra zones needed for regular duels. Rush layouts hide unused-zone markers. Native fields remove the bright edge strip while retaining the dim animated turn indicator.
31. Added animated Duel Links mates with a dedicated DL source tab, original model variants and separate cosmetic identities. Fixed native texture loading when switching mates and preserved each model's authored animation and native material variants.
32. Added optional Duel Links summon animations with original audio, localized title artwork and native level/rank graphics. The viewer keeps different animations of the same card as separate choices. Existing official, custom and Rush cut-ins retain their duel priority.
33. Corrected colors, missing blur effects and playback failures in several Duel Links summon animations, including Blue-Eyes, Dark Magician, Neos, Red-Eyes, Malefic Truth Dragon and Relinquished. Fixed missing-script warnings in affected animations.
34. Restored Mate viewer background music, sorted Duel Links mates by their localized names, corrected Malefic and Royal Rebel preview framing, and fixed Cross Duel Exodia disappearing during duels.
35. Added Relinquished as a Duel Links mate using its original model and five-part summon animation. It holds the original final pose between summons and uses a larger placement scale during duels.
36. Corrected Soulburner and Flame's character portraits and restored proper Spell/Trap symbols on both manga card styles.
37. Leaving a finished online match now works even when the side-deck message has already arrived. Tag and 2v2 portraits and voices now follow the shared character and active player seat.
38. New replay recordings preserve card finishes and decorations. Existing recordings retain any appearance information they already contain.
39. Wallpaper and title-screen choices now save immediately, with atomic settings replacement to protect the previous complete configuration.
40. Clicking empty space inside the Deck Editor filter panel no longer cancels it. New decks start blank; importing a deck code remains an explicit action.
41. Restored aspect-ratio scaling when leaving deck screens, preventing a previous layout transition from overwriting the current duel scale.
42. Restored final-blow presentation for lethal piercing damage using the actual damage reported by the duel core.
43. Updates now wait for the installation helper to start before closing the game and reject competing installers. The Windows helper shows MDPro4 installation progress and a visible failure message with access to its log.
44. Fixed synced deck replacements losing their server identity, which could cause duplicate uploads on a later sync.
45. Completed missing Training and Forbidden Memories labels and story dialogue across supported languages, localized missing Solo AI entries, and corrected Card Position translations. Empty native campaign descriptions no longer fall back to English development text.
46. Restored card inspection from the duel log and kept large hands on screen while browsing the curved fan.
47. Fixed the solid white Apply Set window on Android by restoring its missing frame and button artwork.
48. Chain animations stay hidden while their card artwork loads, preventing a dark placeholder flash before playback.
49. Fixed Snowy woodland appearing pink on Android.
50. Leaving the update screen now cancels a pending installer handoff safely. Linux and macOS updates verify the target version before applying files and before reporting success.
51. Card ID mapping downloads now preserve valid cached data after a bad response and recover correctly when the local mapping file is missing or replaced.
52. Fixed an old battle music loop escaping BGM mute after its sound bank was loaded again. Consecutive voice lines from the same player now wait for the previous line to finish, including Yuya's Pendulum scale dialogue.
53. Card ID mappings now download from MDPro4's Cloudflare service, with reviewed corrections and historical aliases preserved. Imported decks keep pre-release IDs until their official replacement is available in the active card catalog.
54. Pre-release card downloads now prefer Cloudflare and verify package contents before installation, with a matching GitHub fallback. Changing download hosts no longer causes a false update notice for identical cards.
55. Updated the Traditional Chinese card database with 240 additional cards and refreshed existing card data and text. Added missing system and archetype names while preserving existing translations.
56. Completed the 35-puzzle WCS2006 collection, adding puzzles 05, 14, 16 and 32 and repairing compatibility problems in puzzles 24, 34 and 35. Existing mission progress and distinct original variants are retained.

platformNotes.macos:
1. Improved Windows installation speed, progress details and file-integrity checks.
2. Fixed Android touch page snapping when several fingers are used and improved launcher icon quality.
3. Linux and macOS updates preserve executable permissions.
4. Android installation includes all startup data in Part 1 and confirms when each part is safe to close. Normal game updates remain available after installation.
5. Linux and macOS now offer a graphical offline setup wizard with destination selection, progress, repair, retry, settings-preserving reinstall and desktop shortcuts.
6. Fixed the white Public Deck Search footer and missing Deck Appearance Details close icon on Android.
7. Fixed black card faces and repeated card names on Shine cards on Android, and restored missing card rendering on Linux.
8. Windows setup identifies missing or damaged download parts, supports long paths and shows translated repair instructions.
9. Restored the confirmation-button order setting for mouse and touch users.
10. Fixed installed Cross Duel mates not sharing their appearance in online duels.
11. Added missing pack and V Jump magazine covers to the pack browser.
12. Improved localized deck-editor tabs so longer labels stay on one line.
13. Duel card details no longer appear over the Settings window.
14. Added TCG, OCG, TCG + OCG and Rush Duel presets directly beside the deck-editor filters, plus a Legend card filter.
15. Fixed summon effects failing to load from duplicate resource files and leaving summoned cards displayed at their previous location.
16. Fixed repeated chain and summon effects failing after earlier playback.
17. Fixed rapidly opened and closed submenus leaving the interface stuck or blocking card selection.
18. Long deck names now stay inside the name field.
19. Added optional smaller/larger card-text buttons, enabled from Display settings.
20. Card image export preserves color without changing the displayed card texture.
21. DUEL ADVENTURES uses uppercase menu labels in all supported languages.
22. Fixed background music restarting on repeated requests and overlapping when switching duel stages. Summon effects now use their intended music fade strength and timing.
23. Overframe summons use their own sound instead of the Super Polymerization placeholder.
24. Selecting a replay now allows deck inspection before playback, and the final OK action exits the replay.
25. The duel timer displays the active opponent's countdown as well as your own.
26. Cards leaving the field no longer retain the field's negated appearance in the Graveyard.
27. Fixed the pre-processing anti-aliasing setting always reverting to Off.
28. Banished cards keep their intended rotation during movement.
29. Selecting Solo opponents and opening the deck format selector plays the menu confirmation sound. Longer format labels fit inside the selector.
30. Improved card database loading on installations that prevent SQLite from creating temporary transaction files, addressing missing duel fields and Solo startup failures.
31. Failed AI starts now show an error and release their local room safely instead of closing the game.
32. Both player-name buttons in replay details open the corresponding recorded deck, including clicks around the button edges.
33. Solo discovers newly installed supported bots and lets you customize each opponent's artwork through Data/Windbot/BotCatalog.json.
34. Low deck counts no longer overlap card names or other duel panels.
35. Improved menu scrolling and keyboard navigation, with settings and list entries kept inside their panels.
36. Refreshed the background picker with distinct previews, clearer selection borders and a working Neos preview. Custom images appear once, with separate style controls.
37. Restored the default TCG card sleeve on installations where it is included with the base resources, including macOS.
38. Fixed white shapes around the Forest field by restoring its missing leaf-shadow effect (macOS specific). 
39. Fixed Rush summon effects failing when other visual overlays are active, and earlier effect failures preventing a later duel from starting after successful cleanup.
40. Card details no longer apply the screen's safe-area margin twice on mobile devices.
41. Rock-Paper-Scissors and turn-order prompts from an old connection no longer appear late or send a choice into a newly joined room.
42. Deluxe mate transformations stop and release their effects when leaving a duel. Mate materials are released when models are replaced or retired.
43. Added optional Discord Rich Presence and invitations to public waiting rooms on supported servers.
44. Added a direct Tag Duel option for Evolution casual play and controls for turn time, starting LP, hand size, draw count, Master Rule, card pool and available server banlists.
45. Room settings now explain unsupported values and oversized room codes before joining, while preserving your selected rules.
46. Mates such as Galatea no longer block clicks on cards in the Field Spell zone.
47. Shining Neos Wingman now opens in its idle animation in the mate viewer instead of briefly showing a T-pose.
48. LAN rooms now offer Master Rules 1–5 and Rush Duel. Rush rooms use their own rules and are recognized by joining updated clients.
49. Joining LAN and supported online rooms preserves the room's Master Rule when the duel starts or resumes.
50. The opponent's timer now pauses when the server processes their response, keeping both displayed countdowns aligned through animations.
51. Pre-release server disconnect and reconnect notices now update the existing player connection icons.
52. Known pre-release server notices and tips are translated into all supported languages, with clearer instructions for reconnecting with the original unchanged deck.
53. Chat messages use a consistent readable text size and expand to fit their contents. Server welcome information is organized into separate lines.
54. Fixed unresponsive duel controls when a fast room start or reconnect arrives before the room screen finishes loading.
55. Resynchronizing a duel preserves the turn information received from the server and no longer resets turn-based voice cues.
56. Evolution reconnects wait for the previous duel view to close before restoring the field, preventing overlapping views and lost recovery packets.
57. Translated more pre-release server tips, including group information, connection advice and card-dealer jokes.
58. Pasted room invitation links now accept surrounding spaces and line breaks.
59. Fixed white Retry and OK button backgrounds on the duel result screen on mobile devices.
60. Confirming a completed Single or Tag duel now exits correctly without asking you to surrender again or leaving the field controls hidden.
61. Fixed missing or misplaced Life Points after profile updates in the mobile duel layout.
62. Connection icons remain visible after an unexpected disconnect and correctly identify opponents when custom names are used.
63. Evolution rooms no longer show an unsupported Add an AI Bot option.
64. Fixed missing commas and other fallback characters in the mate list, including search results.
65. Added Card Mates beside Hologram in Duel, Spectate and Replay settings.
    Display available Master Duel and Cross Duel mates above matching face-up monsters, with idle and supported battle animations. The option starts off and updates immediately when changed.
66. Fixed repeated missing-script warnings from an obsolete component in the default rendering profile.
67. Refreshed the Home community and support artwork and improved text contrast.
68. Fixed tapping outside the mobile duel timeline failing to close it, and corrected timeline scrollbar hit testing on desktop.
69. Added the newly imported GX characters to the editable roster and assigned the new Jaden/Yubel and Yubel alternates their original voices.
